summary: Independently verified the inline @ai model-selection picker on web (all 4 flows end-to-end + DB persistence) and mobile (inline banner + modal + selection + send + DB persistence). All backend metadata.selected_models + metadata.remember_models handling verified — inline_ai_models is persisted correctly and the ai_question thread reuses the picked models. Web is fully green. Mobile inline banner/picker/modal/send is green. The mobile 'remembered pill on retype' scenario could not be verified in a fresh session because on Expo web preview reload the chat details endpoint appears to race with auth token restoration (three /api 401s in console) — the chat header shows 'Chat / 0 members' instead of 'AIConv Test / 1 members' even though messages render. Code logic for the remembered pill (mobile chat/[id].tsx L616-855) is correct; likely just a session-restoration flake in Expo preview.

issues: Radix DialogContent is missing a DialogTitle — console warns: '`DialogContent` requires a `DialogTitle` for the component to be accessible for screen reader users.' Wrap the picker heading in <DialogTitle> (VisuallyHidden if you don't want it visible).

integration_issues.flow: Chat detail load after login on Expo web preview
integration_issues.issue: Three /api requests return 401 in console right after login; the chat state (chat.name, chat.members, chat.inline_ai_models) fails to hydrate on some reloads even though messages render. Likely a race between AsyncStorage token restore (setAuthToken) and the initial useEffect apiGet('/api/chats/{id}') in mobile/app/chat/[id].tsx L219-244. Suggest awaiting the auth-loading state before firing apiGet, or retrying once on 401 after token is ready.

parity_issues.issue: Could not be verified via UI on Expo web preview due to the chat-state load flake above. On web, the retype flow shows 'Ask AI with X · remembered' pill (no popover nag) as expected.
parity_issues.expected: On mobile retype '@ai', banner suppressed and pill 'Using: X · remembered' shown
parity_issues.actual: Chat state didn't hydrate in fresh session so rememberedModels stayed [] and the banner reappeared (not a code bug in the picker itself — chat load flake)

context_for_next_testing_agent: The feature is functionally complete. If you re-verify the mobile 'remembered pill on retype' end-to-end, do it in a SINGLE session without page.goto reloads (i.e., after login, tap through the chat list to open the chat via UI) — page reloads on Expo web preview appear to lose the module-level _token, causing the chat details apiGet to 401 while messages load via WebSocket. Alternatively, wait ≥10s after login before navigating.
rca of the issue: Mobile chat-load flake: /app/mobile/src/api.ts stores the JWT in a module-level variable `_token`. On a fresh document load, the auth provider hydrates the token from AsyncStorage in an effect, but the chat screen's initial useEffect may fire the first apiGet('/api/chats/{id}') before setAuthToken() runs, producing a 401 that leaves chat state null. Messages come in later via WebSocket (ws-token has its own retry) which is why the message list shows despite chat being null. Fix: gate the initial useEffect in mobile/app/chat/[id].tsx on `!loading` from useAuth() OR retry once on 401 after auth is ready.
